task: Produce a comparison table template of clause topics and a short explanation of Article 28.
text: Our legal ops team is comparing how Microsoft, Salesforce and Google structure their publicly posted data-processing addendums. We want to see which of them refer to the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (Commission Implementing Decision 2021/914) and which mention ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 27018. Under the GDPR, Article 28 requires a written contract between controller and processor, and Article 32 covers security of processing. Separately, our contract management tool, version 4.2.1, returns an HTTP 500 error when we upload a PDF over 25 MB, and the vendor's public docs only mention port 443. Please give us a comparison table template listing the clause topics to compare, and explain briefly what Article 28 requires of a processor contract.
